analysis.interpretation: With 40 execution traces (2 real EXECUTION, 38 EXECUTION_SIMULATED), 56/61 contracts were promoted to STATIC_DYNAMIC_SUPPORTED. Dynamic validation rate = 91.8%. CardDemo COBOL programs require DB2/CICS/IMS stubs not available in this environment; EMPPAY/DEPTPAY are standalone programs not referenced by JCL contracts. JCL ordering traces (EXECUTION_SIMULATED) provide temporal ordering evidence but the ReconciliationEngine requires event.artifact_id to match contract subject_id/object_id.

artifact_mapping.note: C1 fix: ArtifactMapper applied per-JCL. EXACT/PROC_EXPANDED mappings replace program names with step entity IDs. AMBIGUOUS mappings are logged and never guessed. MISSING events keep original artifact_id.

notes: SYNTHETIC_STATIC traces excluded per SI-01 (never used for promotion).
EXECUTION traces from EMPPAY/DEPTPAY do not match JCL contracts (different programs).
EXECUTION_SIMULATED JCL ordering traces provide step-ordering evidence.
Full RQ3 dynamic coverage experiment requires executing the actual batch programs with test data.
This result demonstrates the pipeline works end-to-end with real GnuCOBOL traces.
